design_decisions.topology: Per-DC two-tier Clos (2x Nexus 9364C spines, 93180YC-FX ToR/storage leafs, 9336C-FX2 border leafs). Each leaf has 2x100G to each spine. Servers and storage arrays are dual-homed to the rack ToR pair over 25G DAC.
design_decisions.dci: Full mesh between the four DCs via the Melbourne and Sydney Mega Pods, not direct DC-DC dark fibre. Each DC is dual-homed only to MEGAPOD1 (Melbourne) and MEGAPOD2 (Sydney) with two 100G dark-fibre circuits per pod (16 access circuits). Logical DCI EVPL/cross-connect circuits exist for every DC pair on both of those paths (12 circuits). Adelaide (MEGAPOD3) is not a third DC dual-home; it joins the interconnect fabric with two diverse wavelengths to Melbourne and two to Sydney (four waves plus the existing Melbourne–Sydney pair). DCs reach Adelaide by transiting MP1 or MP2 and those waves.
design_decisions.cloud: Azure ExpressRoute, AWS Direct Connect and GCP Cloud Interconnect terminate at every Mega Pod (9 circuits). Melbourne (MEGAPOD1) uses the native regions Australia Southeast, ap-southeast-4 and australia-southeast2. Sydney (MEGAPOD2) uses Australia East, ap-southeast-2 and australia-southeast1. Adelaide has no hyperscaler region: its three circuits are partner/edge on-ramps backhauled primarily to the Melbourne regions, with diversity via the Sydney regions over the MP3–MP1 and MP3–MP2 wavelengths. Provider side is a Provider Network; customer side lands on MMR-B and is patched to the cloud on-ramp routers.
design_decisions.power: Dual 230V/32A single-phase feeds per rack, 80% max utilisation (5888 W per feed). 2N capacity equals one feed. Dual-PSU allocated_draw is split per PSU so A+B does not double-count.
design_decisions.reuse: Reuse manufacturer 'cisco' and roles 'spine'/'leaf' without modifying them. Create all other manufacturers, roles and device types new.
design_decisions.addresses: Site physical addresses are city and state only (no street-level fiction): Sydney NSW, Melbourne VIC, Brisbane QLD, Perth WA, Adelaide SA.

sites.name: MEGAPOD3
sites.description: Carrier-neutral Mega Pod / meet-me hub — Adelaide (5 x 42U racks)

growth_headroom.comment: Headroom remains in every compute rack (servers occupy U3-17; U19-38 are free) and on unused leaf 25G downlinks. DCI and cloud growth lands at the Mega Pod MMR spare panels. Adelaide XCH ports 0-3 are reserved for a future direct DC dual-home; today DCs reach Adelaide via Melbourne/Sydney.
